name: hallmark
description: Anti-AI-slop design skill for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.
readmeExcerpt:
# Hallmark **A design skill for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex that refuses to look AI-generated.** [Live demo →](https://www.usehallmark.com)  ·  twenty themes  ·  four verbs  ·  press `T` to cycle. Made by Together AI.

Hallmark picks a macrostructure for the brief, dresses it in one of twenty themes, runs fifty-seven slop-test gates plus a pre-emit self-critique, and refuses the on-distribution defaults every LLM was trained into. Two pages by Hallmark for two different briefs feel like different sites, not colour-swaps of the same template. --- ## Four verbs | Verb | What it does | | --- | --- | | *(default)* | Build new UI. Picks a macrostructure, applies the rule-set, runs the slop test before handing back. | | `hallmark audit ` | Score existing code against the anti-patterns. Punch list, no edits. | | `hallmark redesign ` | Throw out the structure, keep copy + IA + brand, rebuild with a different fingerprint. | | `hallmark study ` | Extract the **DNA** from a design you admire: macrostructure, type-pairing, colour anchor. Refuses pixel-clones and paid templates. Optionally emits a portable `design.md` for handoff to other AI tools. | --- ## Different briefs, different shapes Each generated from a different brief. The skill picks the theme, structure, and craft to fit each one, not from a template.

Each page is self-contained HTML + CSS, stamped with its macrostructure in the CSS comment. Browse the full set at [usehallmark.com](https://www.usehallmark.com) or under [`site/_tests/`](site/_tests/). --- ## Custom NEW When a brief carries creative intent that no catalog theme fits, Hallmark switches to **Custom** and designs the page from scratch: a made-to-measure palette, type, and layout. Same 57 slop-test gates, no template underneath.

It stays a quiet branch; vanilla briefs never see it. The protocol lives in [`custom-theme.md`](skills/hallmark/references/custom-theme.md). --- ## Install ``` npx skills add nutlope/hallmark ``` Re-run any time to update. Or copy [`SKILL.md`](skills/hallmark/SKILL.md) + [`references/`](skills/hallmark/references/) into: - **Claude Code**: `~/.claude/skills/hallmark/` - **Cursor**: `.cursor/rules/hallmark.mdc` (body of `SKILL.md`, no frontmatter) - **Codex**: `~/.codex/skills/hallmark/` (personal) or `.codex/skills/hallmar

aiSummary.whatItDoes: Hallmark is a design skill for AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex that generates unique web interfaces that do not resemble typical AI-generated outputs. It employs a selection of themes and structures, along with a rigorous testing process to ensure each design feels distinct and tailored to specific briefs.
aiSummary.whyItMatters: This tool addresses the growing concern of AI-generated designs appearing generic and unoriginal, providing a solution for developers seeking unique, high-quality design outputs. By emphasizing individuality in design, it enhances the creative potential of AI-assisted development.
useCases: Generate unique web interfaces for various projects
Audit existing designs for adherence to design principles
Redesign interfaces while preserving core content
Extract design elements from admired works
Create portable design documentation for collaboration
aiSummary.gettingStarted: To begin using Hallmark, visit the live demo at https://www.usehallmark.com and explore the available themes and functionalities.
